## [placeholder] Three commands to go on air

```bash
# Wire the box (the address is never shown on screen)
make ans-set ENV=cloud IP=<the box's address>
# Open the SSH tunnel to the box
make ssh-tunnel ENV=cloud
# Serve the app on the laptop (127.0.0.1 only, the default)
cd ~/TalkWithZombies-client
.venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000
```

::: {.notes}
The wiring and the tunnel are done before the talk, not live.
